title.zh: v2.0.30 播放中切换曲风从头起播与视听试听全链路声学同步：切换时干净重置播放头并从第一拍开始、试听与详情页完整继承真实BPM/Swing/鼓机模型、WAV导出Swing倍率归一化
title.en: v2.0.30 Transport Playback Reset on Genre Switch & Audition Acoustic Fidelity: Clean playhead reset and restart from downbeat when switching genres during playback, audition & detail previews inherit authentic BPM/Swing/DrumKit, and WAV export swing normalization

highlights.zh: **播放中切换曲风从头开始播放（Transport Playback Restart on Downbeat）**：解决在序列器正在播放时切换曲风，新曲风半路承接上一曲风步进指针与拍子偏移的割裂感。现在切换曲风时检测若处于播放状态，自动执行 stop() 并彻底重置播放头（clearPlayhead()），随后从第 0 步/第一小节第 1 拍从头启动播放，保证新曲风节奏与和声从第一拍干净利落实时呈现。
highlights.en: **Transport Playback Reset on Genre Switch**: Resolved an issue where switching genres while the transport was running caused the new genre to resume from an arbitrary mid-bar step and phase offset. When switching during active playback, the engine now cleanly stops, resets the playhead via clearPlayhead(), and restarts from step 0 (downbeat of bar 1).

highlights.zh: **全站曲风试听与详情页声学全要素同步（Audition Acoustic Parity）**：修复悬浮试听（useGenreAudition）与曲风详情预览（GenreDetailView）未继承该曲风专属 BPM、Swing 与硬件鼓机模型的痛点。setPattern(..., resetStates = true) 现在自动同步曲风自带速度、Swing 微时序（支持百分比与 0..0.75 比例）以及真实鼓机型号（808/909/Acoustic/Cyber），在全站任意卡片试听 174 BPM Drum & Bass 或 35% 摇摆 Boom Bap 均能立即听到该曲风地道标志性的律动与音色。
highlights.en: **Audition Acoustic Parity**: Overhauled preview auditioning in hover cards and GenreDetailView to strictly adhere to authentic genre tempo, swing micro-timing, and drum machine models (808/909/Acoustic/Cyber) via setPattern(..., resetStates = true). Auditioning Drum & Bass at 174 BPM or Boom Bap with 35% swing immediately conveys the authentic acoustic groove.

highlights.zh: **WAV 离线导出 Swing 溢出归一化修复**：修复 WavExporter 在处理大于 1 的 Swing 百分比值（如 15% 或 35%）时未除以 100 进行比例归一化，导致直接被 Math.min(0.75, ...) 截断为极限摇摆 0.75 的声学缺陷。离线导出渲染现与实时音频引擎完全保持一致。
highlights.en: **WAV Offline Export Swing Normalization**: Corrected swing parsing in WavExporter to properly normalize percentage-based swing (> 1) by dividing by 100 before clamping to 0.75, eliminating acoustic distortion and achieving 100% parity with live playback.
